issue_context.title: Bug: convertToExcalidrawElements on type: "frame" ignores x and y properties when manually set
comments: I'd always prefer user-defined values for `x`/`y`/`height`/`width`. Checking https://github.com/excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw, it shouldn't cause any issues. /cc @ad1992

We do prefer user params over default values https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/f4dd23fc31e218298bacce3ab39c2556fd12e639/packages/excalidraw/data/transform.ts#L593 so not sure why the above isn't working, I will look into it.

@dwelle not sure why you linked mermaid-to-excalidraw repo here ?

We handle frames specially:

https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/f4dd23fc31e218298bacce3ab39c2556fd12e639/packages/excalidraw/data/transform.ts#L719-L773

Here you mentioned you didn't want to complicate the frame use case:

https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/7205#discussion_r1378571137

As for the mermaid-to-excalidraw, I was checking if we don't rely on some implicit behavior there, and it doesn't seem so.

As such, changing the code linked above to prefer the user-supplied values should be safe.

> We handle frames specially:
> 
> https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/f4dd23fc31e218298bacce3ab39c2556fd12e639/packages/excalidraw/data/transform.ts#L719-L773
> 
> Here you mentioned you didn't want to complicate the frame use case:
> 
> [#7205 (comment)](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/7205#discussion_r1378571137)
> 
> As for the mermaid-to-excalidraw, I was checking if we don't rely on some implicit behavior there, and it doesn't seem so.
> 
> As such, changing the code linked above to prefer the user-supplied values should be safe.

Yes I think should be fine, we can give preference to user values always irrespective of how the actual diagram turns out to be. I will raise a PR for the same.

review_comments: I'd do this only in DEV, and possibly only if `frame.children` is defined, also.
